observations: Original SNL137 anchor-pin assembly contains M363 and one3/16in×2in split pin, corroborated by SNL141:012. Do not use the earlier tentative reading5/16×2¼.
Original SNL229 M367 strap costs8.20; long3.50 plus short4.70 equals8.20, corroborating HB complete-strap wording. Model M367 as hierarchy/assembly without another solid.
HB154 says six3/8in set screws uncouple long/short ends. SNL253:002 lists twelve MX38 anchor-to-end screws; allocate six to each high-speed brake as a supported interpretation.
SNL191 assigns six5/16×1 steel countersunk rivets per M361 and three5/16×1⅛ per M359/M360 free end. Original SNL8/9 composition was inspected in previous packet.
HB133/SNL30 depict the anchor eye on the rear lower part of the brake and exposed outer coupling heads.
decisions: Extend the rear steel tails into an unlined joint gap instead of overlapping printed lining stock. Retain both printed lining lengths and holes; their clocking is revised from the initial estimate.
M361 is a curved stepped outer doubler with a separate integral pin eye. A thickened long-band end receives coupling screws; section, screw length and reinforcement form are estimates.
Outer screw heads, through clearances, receiving-thread engagement volumes and independent steel-rivet bearing seats must be checked in saved geometry.
Free-end eye/fold design and its three rivets per band remain a separate unresolved construction task; do not mark the backings complete.
provenance_note: Additional source packet; initial band source inventory and trial01 remain frozen.
